To —— (‘The serpent is shut out from Paradise’)
The sole textual authority for To —— (‘The serpent is shut out from Paradise’) is a very neat
copy in S.’s best hand, written in double column on one side of a single sheet and with the
title To —— written clearly above the left-hand column. It is possible, as Nora Crook has
argued (BSM xii 141 and p. xxix) that one of ‘the many pages torn between pp. 93 and 72
reverso’ from Nbk 19 may once have held a rough draft of the poem. S. sent the fair copy
MS to Edward Williams on Saturday 26 January 1822 together with a covering note (repro-
duced in facsimile in MYRS viii 414) to My dear Williams:
